reasoning: This was a Phase 1 dose-escalation safety study that met its primary endpoint. Step 1 (TARGET ENGAGEMENT): Evidence shows dose-proportional plasma exposure with measurable Cmax values (126-580 µg/mL) and drug accumulation at Week 20, indicating the compound reached systemic circulation. Step 2 (PATHWAY MODULATION): No biomarker data provided to assess amyloid fibril targeting or clearance. Step 3 (CLINICAL TRANSLATION): Primary endpoint was safety/tolerability, which was met with no dose-limiting toxicities in the first 4 weeks across all dose levels. Step 4 (POPULATION EFFECTS): No subgroup analysis reported. Step 5 (CONFOUNDERS): Notable safety signals including cardiac failure (6/25 participants) and cardiac arrhythmias, but these did not constitute dose-limiting toxicities per protocol definition. The trial successfully established a recommended Phase 2 dose of 1000 mg/m².

failure_modes.evidence: While systemic exposure was achieved, no biomarker data was provided to confirm amyloid fibril targeting or downstream biological effects on amyloid deposits
